description: This class, ModuleFileParser, processes and parses an OpenMRS module's config.xml file within a JAR (omod) file into a Module object. It reads the module's metadata, dependencies, extensions, privileges, global properties, conditional resources, and other configuration elements to facilitate module management within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ModuleFileParser
classes.description: A parser class that reads module configuration files from an OMOD file and converts them into Module objects, extracting details like name, id, dependencies, extensions, privileges, and conditional resources.

methods.name: parse(File)
methods.description: Parses the given OMOD file, extracting and constructing a Module object from its config.xml.

methods.name: parse(InputStream)
methods.description: Parses the module InputStream by temporarily storing it as a file and then processing it.

methods.name: getModuleConfigXml(File)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the config.xml entry from the module's jar file.

methods.name: createModule(Document, File)
methods.description: Constructs a Module instance from the parsed XML Document.
